rule: This template is not an operational approval record. No gate may be marked passed based on this template. Unknown, missing, partial, or stale evidence is not a pass.

gates.name: C0 semantic contract and C1-C4 evidence baseline
required_evidence: exact C1 product profile and reproducible build/preprocess evidence
C2 dependency drift dispositions with evidence
C4 closure report and binding verification
gates.decision_reason: Preparation records report upstream gates blocked or incomplete; resolve against the current authoritative artifacts before changing status.

gates.name: Detector and execution environment freeze
required_evidence: independent freeze approval before source selection
gates.decision_reason: No frozen independent-evaluation release is recorded in this preparation package.

gates.name: Complete development, tuning, and exposure family inventory
required_evidence: reconciled tracked and untracked local history
authorized external tuning and patch-family inventory
gates.decision_reason: Only a partial reachable local-history review and public development exposure metadata are recorded; external/untracked history remains unresolved.

gates.name: Protocol and rubric independent review and freeze
required_evidence: approved SHA-256 and effective UTC time
gates.decision_reason: The supplied protocol remains preparation_only and UNFROZEN.

gates.name: Role qualification, conflicts, and access-control readiness
required_evidence: two qualified reviewers cleared before access
separate qualified adjudicator cleared before access
verified isolated workspaces and append-only audit log
gates.decision_reason: No named roles, cleared declarations, or deployed access-control evidence are included in this preparation package.

gates.name: Candidate-frame eligibility and whole-family exclusions
required_evidence: all unknown/overlapping families excluded or resolved
selection frame and method frozen before exposure
gates.decision_reason: No source selection is authorized while family closure and upstream freezes are unresolved.

gates.name: Source and randomized-ID manifest freeze
required_evidence: source identity and content digests in restricted manifest
CSPRNG ID-list digest and uniqueness evidence
two-person encrypted map custody and access audit
gates.decision_reason: No candidates or source manifest may be created during preparation.

gates.name: Independent labels and adjudication freeze
required_evidence: final label ledger digest and independent audit attestation
gates.decision_reason: No label work is authorized during preparation.

gates.name: Prediction execution and escrow seal
required_evidence: frozen detector applied to frozen source manifest
prediction payload digest and execution log
gates.decision_reason: No prediction may be generated or opened during preparation.

gates.name: Joint reveal authorization and separately authorized scoring
required_evidence: joint reveal approval by coordinator and independent auditor
separately approved scoring protocol and scope
gates.decision_reason: Reveal and scoring are not authorized by this preparation package.

prohibited_during_preparation: access to admin-only escrow or hidden labels
